title: Day 1: The Shahada — Your Door
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 1 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 1 — The Shahada — Your Door
chapters.body:
The testimony that none deserves worship but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Messenger, is the door into Islam. You do not need to know everything first — you need only believe it sincerely, as the Prophet ﷺ taught: 'Islam is built on five' (Bukhari 8), and this is the first.

In the Qur'an: 'Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam' (3:19).

Today's step: Say the shahada aloud, even alone, even quietly: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Allah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan Rasulullah. Then write down the date — your Islam has a birthday now.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 2: The Five Pillars — the Frame of the House
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 2 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 2 — The Five Pillars — the Frame of the House
chapters.body:
Islam stands on five: the testimony, the prayer, the alms, the fast of Ramadan, and the pilgrimage for those able. They are not a test to pass but a house to live in, built one room at a time over your whole life.

In the Qur'an: 'And establish prayer and give zakat and bow with those who bow' (2:43).

Today's step: Read the five pillars once more (Huda has the guides) and learn just their NAMES by heart — that is today's whole task.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 3: Talking to Allah — Your First Dua
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 3 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 3 — Talking to Allah — Your First Dua
chapters.body:
Before rules, a relationship. Allah says: 'Call upon Me; I will answer you' (40:60). There is no intermediary and no special language required in your own words — the daily duas shelf gives you the Prophet's ﷺ words for every moment.

In the Qur'an: 'And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed, I am near' (2:186).

Today's step: Say one dua in your own words today — ask for help, gratitude, or guidance. One honest sentence is a complete prayer.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 4: Wudu — Washing Before Standing
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 4 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 4 — Wudu — Washing Before Standing
chapters.body:
Purification before prayer is a mercy, not a burden: water washes the limbs and slows the heart. The Prophet ﷺ said cleanliness is half of faith (Muslim 223).

In the Qur'an: 'Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves' (2:222).

Today's step: Learn wudu once, step by step (Huda's Wudu guide). Do it slowly, even if you are alone. Feel the water — this is preparation for standing before the King.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 5: Your First Prayer — Two Rak'ahs
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 5 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 5 — Your First Prayer — Two Rak'ahs
chapters.body:
The five daily prayers are meetings with Allah — not performances. Start with two. Stand, recite al-Fatihah (the opening of the Qur'an), bow, prostrate. The words come with repetition; the presence comes with sincerity.

In the Qur'an: 'Indeed, prayer restrains from immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater' (29:45).

Today's step: Pray two rak'ahs today, however imperfectly. Wasia's lessons and the Huda prayer guide stand beside you. Imperfect and done beats perfect and postponed.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 6: Meeting the Qur'an — Al-Fatihah
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 6 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 6 — Meeting the Qur'an — Al-Fatihah
chapters.body:
The Qur'an is Allah's direct speech, preserved for fourteen centuries. Begin with al-Fatihah — the seven verses you will recite in every prayer for the rest of your life. Recite it; its meaning: praise, mercy, and the straight road.

In the Qur'an: 'This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for the righteous' (2:2).

Today's step: Read al-Fatihah in translation once, then listen to a reciter say it (the Player and Qur'an sections). Let your ears learn before your tongue does.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 7: Who Was Muhammad ﷺ?
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 7 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 7 — Who Was Muhammad ﷺ?
chapters.body:
The final Messenger — a man whose enemies could not fault his honesty, who wept over his ummah, who said 'I was sent to perfect noble character' (Ahmad 8952). Loving him is part of loving the message he carried.

In the Qur'an: 'And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds' (21:107).

Today's step: Read one story from the Seerah shelf today — any one. Notice how he treated the weak, the children, his enemies. That is the sunnah in one word: mercy.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 8: The Mosque — Your Second Home
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 8 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 8 — The Mosque — Your Second Home
chapters.body:
The masjid is not a building; it is the heartbeat of the community. Enter it with wudu, pray two rak'ahs of greeting, sit. No one will ask for your credentials — the mosque's door does not check papers.

In the Qur'an: 'And the mosques are for Allah, so do not invoke anyone with Allah' (72:18).

Today's step: Visit a mosque this week — for prayer, or even ten quiet minutes. Introduce yourself to ONE person. That single handshake is how community begins.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 9: Halal and the Table
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 9 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 9 — Halal and the Table
chapters.body:
What you eat carries worship with it: 'O you who believe, eat of the good things We have provided you' (2:172). The basics: no pork, no alcohol, and meat slaughtered according to the rite — the Tayyib module walks you gently through the rest.

In the Qur'an: 'Forbidden to you are dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine...' (5:3).

Today's step: Check your kitchen today; replace one doubtful item. Small steps, no panic — and ask at the masjid when unsure. Questions are worship too.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 10: The First Ten — a Rest and a Review
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 10 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 10 — The First Ten — a Rest and a Review
chapters.body:
Ten days in, you have stood, washed, spoken to Allah, met His Book and His Messenger, and entered His house. That is more than most people do in a decade of thinking about it.

In the Qur'an: 'Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear' (2:286).

Today's step: Rest today — review nothing. Say alhamdulillah, and know: the next twenty days continue this pace. Islam was built for humans, not angels.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 11: Learning Al-Fatihah by Heart
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 11 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 11 — Learning Al-Fatihah by Heart
chapters.body:
Now that your ears know al-Fatihah, let the tongue learn it — a verse a day. It is the greatest surah: 'There is no prayer for the one who does not recite the Opening of the Book' (Bukhari 756).

In the Qur'an: 'And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance — so is there any who will remember?' (54:17).

Today's step: Learn the first two verses of al-Fatihah today — listen five times, then recite five times. The rest arrives day by day.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 12: The Prayer Times — Five Appointments
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 12 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 12 — The Prayer Times — Five Appointments
chapters.body:
Fajr before dawn, Dhuhr at midday, Asr in the afternoon, Maghrib at sunset, Isha at night. The times move with the sun; the app's prayer screen follows your location so you never need to calculate.

In the Qur'an: 'Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers at specified times' (4:103).

Today's step: Do not aim for all five yet. Choose ONE prayer this week — the easiest for your schedule — and guard it like an appointment with a king. Because it is.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 13: Sujud — the Nearest Place
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 13 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 13 — Sujud — the Nearest Place
chapters.body:
In prostration, the slave is nearest to his Lord (Muslim 482). The forehead touches the earth — the posture of absolute trust. This is where you pour out what words cannot carry.

In the Qur'an: 'Prostrate and draw near to Allah' (96:19).

Today's step: In your next prayer, add one extra moment in sujud — one personal sentence, in any language: gratitude, a worry, a hope. That moment is the whole religion in miniature.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 14: Zakat — the Poor's Right in Your Wealth
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 14 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 14 — Zakat — the Poor's Right in Your Wealth
chapters.body:
Zakat purifies wealth: 2.5% of saved wealth above the nisab, given yearly to the categories Allah named. It is not charity from the rich; it is the poor's right (70:24-25).

In the Qur'an: 'Take from their wealth a charity to purify them' (9:103).

Today's step: Read the Zakat module's introduction — no calculations yet. Today, just learn that in Islam, wealth has an owner above you, and He gave the poor a share.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 15: The Qur'an — Your Daily Portion
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 15 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 15 — The Qur'an — Your Daily Portion
chapters.body:
The Qur'an was revealed over 23 years; it is learned the same way — a little, always. 'The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small' (Bukhari 6464).

In the Qur'an: 'So recite what is easy of it' (73:20).

Today's step: Set a daily portion — even one page, even three lines. Read it with the translation open. One page a day finishes the Qur'an in a year.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 16: Forgiveness — the Door That Never Closes
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 16 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 16 — Forgiveness — the Door That Never Closes
chapters.body:
Whatever came before the shahada is erased; whatever comes after has a door back: 'Allah forgives all sins' (39:53). Despair is the only locked door, and Allah locked it from inside the house of hope.

In the Qur'an: 'Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah' (39:53).

Today's step: Say astaghfirullah ten times today — slowly, knowing what it means. Then let one old guilt go. Allah already has.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 17: Family and Old Friends
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 17 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 17 — Family and Old Friends
chapters.body:
Some around you may not understand your change. The Qur'an's own command: 'kindness and justice' to those who do not fight your faith (60:8). You were not sent to argue; you were sent to be near.

In the Qur'an: 'And argue not with the People of the Scripture except in the best manner' (29:46).

Today's step: Do one ordinary kindness for a family member today — no lectures, no announcements. Let your character carry the message the tongue doesn't need to.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 18: The Weekend Rhythm — Jumu'ah
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 18 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 18 — The Weekend Rhythm — Jumu'ah
chapters.body:
Friday is the weekly gathering: a sermon and a congregational prayer that replaces Dhuhr. 'When the call is made for prayer on Friday, hasten to the remembrance of Allah' (62:9).

In the Qur'an: 'O you who believe! When the call is proclaimed for the prayer on Friday, come to the remembrance of Allah' (62:9).

Today's step: If Friday is near: plan to attend Jumu'ah at the mosque you visited — arrive early, sit, listen. If not: learn what the day means and mark the next one.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 19: Eating with Bismillah
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 19 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 19 — Eating with Bismillah
chapters.body:
The table is worship: 'Mention the name of Allah over it' — and the leftover mercy of a meal shared covers the angels' presence (Muslim 2052).

In the Qur'an: 'So eat of the good things We have provided you, and be grateful to Allah' (2:172).

Today's step: Today: bismillah before eating, alhamdulillah after. Two sentences that turn every meal into prayer — the easiest habit in Islam.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.

title: Day 20: Twenty Days — the Man You Are Becoming
kicker: THE NEW MUSLIM PATH · DAY 20 OF 30
subtitle: One step a day — gently, surely

chapters.heading: Day 20 — Twenty Days — the Man You Are Becoming
chapters.body:
Look back: you testify, you wash, you stand, you bow, you speak to Allah in your own words, you give, you forgive, you gather. Twenty days ago you had not done one of these.

In the Qur'an: 'Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves' (13:11).

Today's step: Rest and review — and if some days were missed, do not restart the count. Just continue. The door was never closed; you were never outside it.

You are not behind, and you are not alone. Every born Muslim had a first day — and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things' (Bukhari 6927). Take today's step, say 'alhamdulillah,' and rest.
